comparisons.peer_topic: Interest Expense Variation and Debt Repayment
comparisons.peer_summary: Interest expense decreased to $92 million in 2024 from $106 million in 2023, primarily driven by the repayment of the 2.95% Senior Notes due in June 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose specific drivers for their 2024 interest expense changes. AVGO experienced a significant increase in interest expense ($3,953 million vs $1,622 million in 2023) primarily driven by debt incurred for the VMware Merger. In contrast, AMD saw a decrease in interest expense ($92 million in 2024 vs $106 million in 2023) primarily driven by the repayment of the 2.95% Senior Notes due in June 2024. While both companies attribute changes to debt-related activities, AVGO's increase was due to new debt from an acquisition, whereas AMD's decrease was due to debt repayment.
